Description: Spatially gridded monthly surface mass balance
Primary_Sensors_Models: RACMO RCM forced by ECMWF reanalysis
Limitation_or_Assumption: Uncertainty ~15%; sensitive to coastal topography downscaling
Assumes tipping-bucket refreezing; does not resolve ice slab impermeability

Description: Annual surface velocity fields on glacier trunks
Limitation_or_Assumption: Pre-2014 has >70% annual gaps in I-Ipp; cannot resolve pre-2014 annual dynamics without models

Description: Solid ice dynamic discharge through flux gates (D)
Primary_Sensors_Models: IOM gate integration (v_perp * H_ice_eq * width * alpha)
Limitation_or_Assumption: Depth-averaged factor alpha (0.95 sliding, 0.80 shearing); thickness product choice

Description: Grounded surface elevation rate of change
Limitation_or_Assumption: Ku-band radar penetration (0.5–4.5 m); ICESat-1 steep slope failure; track gaps
Cannot resolve individual basins (Hp-I vs I-Ipp); leakage across ocean/ice shelf
Benchmark for regional sum ONLY; must NOT be treated as basin ground truth

Epoch_1979_1999: Model output (Regional slab window viscoelastic model)
Primary_Sensors_Models: Nield et al. (2014) / Wolstencroft et al. (2015)
Limitation_or_Assumption: Low-viscosity asthenosphere (10^18 Pa s); highly heterogeneous (+2 to +15 mm/yr)

Description: Instantaneous lithospheric rebound to contemporary unloading
Epoch_2000_2013: Model output (Green's function convolution with ice loss)
Epoch_2014_2024: Model output (Green's function convolution with ice loss)
Limitation_or_Assumption: Coupled to contemporary discharge; concentrated near Larsen A/B outlets

Description: Reconstructed annual grounded ice-eq volume trajectory
Basin_Resolution: Basins Hp-I, I-Ipp, Ipp-J on Domain A
Limitation_or_Assumption: Preserves Bedmap3 and BedMachine baselines separately; no baseline averaging
